brainlife.name: neuro/pet

original.readme: This datatype is written to support PET data conforming (but not limited to) the Brain Imaging Data Structure. For more information about neuro/pet first browse [the PET BIDS spec](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modality-specific-files/positron-emission-tomography.html).

files.desc: NifTI file containing dynamic or static PET imaging data

TSV file containing manual or automatically sampled PET blood data limited to: time, plasma_radioactivity, metabolite_parent_fraction, whole_blood_radioactivity,  metabolite_parent_fraction,  hplc_recover_fractions.
JSON sidecar file containing PET radiochemistry, pharmaceutical, time, reconstruction, hardware, institution, tissue, de-identification, and task data.
JSON file describing the columns contained in a blood.tsv file.
